purpose: Define the machine-readable P143 -> P55 or integration handoff without conflating namespace availability, existing-repository state, operator approval, or execution authorization.

routing_rules.P55_CREATE: destination.provider_state must be AVAILABLE and next_owner must be P55; authorization is preserved as typed evidence and P55 must still gate mutation.
routing_rules.INTEGRATE_EXISTING: destination.provider_state must be EXISTS_OWNED and next_owner must be one of P07/P16/P21; existing destinations do not route through repository creation.
routing_rules.BLOCKED: used for UNVERIFIED, EXISTS_CONFLICT, UNKNOWN_AUTH, UNKNOWN_PERMISSION, UNKNOWN_NETWORK, or UNKNOWN_PROVIDER; no mutation owner may be inferred.

authority_rule: operator_approved and execution_authorization are independent booleans with provenance. Provider state never creates authority.
durability_rule: plan_artifact must carry verifiable LOCAL_TRACKED_FILE or tracked PROVIDER_RECEIPT evidence plus PLAN_ONLY/FULL write authority. Arbitrary location strings are not durability proof.
